name: What factors drive the overall cost of a multi-room remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors drive the overall cost of a multi-room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs for multi-room interior renovations vary widely based on square footage, room types, and chosen finishes. High-impact areas like kitchens and bathrooms carry higher costs due to plumbing fixtures, cabinetry, custom tile, and stone surfaces. Living rooms, hallways, and bedrooms are typically less expensive per square foot because they primarily require framing, drywall repairs, trim, and painting. Establishing a clear scope upfront, choosing finish materials early, and setting aside a 10 to 15 percent contingency reserve will help keep your project on budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Total costs depend on room types, square footage, structural wall changes, and the balance between tile/plumbing work and simpler drywall or paint finishes.
